record_title: Exact complete-Bernstein scale thresholds for the largest Gegenbauer zeros in degrees four and five
provenance: Exact factorization of the degree-four and degree-five Gegenbauer zero equations, complete-Bernstein closure properties, Pick-boundary obstruction, and Stieltjes inversion applied to the largest-zero scale family studied in arXiv:2609.19186.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The theorem resolves only the largest-zero scale thresholds in degrees four and five; it does not prove the apparent d_max=n-1 pattern for n>=6, classify other scale functions, or extend to other orthogonal-polynomial families. Recent or differently phrased equivalent observations remain a residual literature risk. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
